name: Config Drift Blows Up Terraform Apply
description: Someone hand-edited the prod security group last quarter to debug a partner integration. The change was never reflected in Terraform. Today's apply tries to enforce the IaC-declared rule set, removes the extra rule, and breaks the partner integration mid-day.
reasoning: Three modelled services (the API and partner-bridge plus a Postgres) sit behind security groups whose state is the focus. The simulation shows the partner-bridge going degraded the instant the SG drift is reconciled.

nodes.label: partner-bridge-svc
nodes.notes: Talks to partner.example.com over an undocumented SG hole.

narrative.text: Steady traffic; partner-bridge succeeding through the manual SG rule.
Scheduled terraform apply runs; refreshes SG to declared state.
Manual rule allowing 198.51.100.0/24 → 8443 removed; partner integration starts failing.
Partner pages support; on-call diffs SG history and finds the apply.
Engineer adds the rule back to Terraform with a clear comment + ticket reference and applies.
Partner integration restored; backlog of failed jobs being retried.
Steady state. Action: enable Driftctl + nightly drift reports for prod accounts.
